clustering.repeat_observation_assumption: Repeated outcomes within a skill bundle or held-out case are not independent; inference must preserve both clusters.

missingness_policy.primary_outcome: No imputation. Any unapproved technical exclusion or missing primary outcome holds confirmatory claim support.
missingness_policy.reporting: Report counts and reasons by preregistered cell before analysis.

requirements: Report exclusions by arm and reason.
Profile 2 never promotes a supporting claim when any technical exclusion occurs.
